Permanent lights, installed properly

Permanent lights stay up all year and change colour from an app, so you can use them for Christmas, Halloween, game days or every night.

Getting them straight, secure and neatly powered along a roofline is the hard part. That's the part I do.

  • Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights and similar kits
  • Bring your own kit, or I pick one up from Costco
  • Run cleanly and evenly along your roofline
  • Fastening points shown to you before I start
  • Power run neatly to your outdoor outlet
  • Single and two-storey homes

Good questions

Permanent light questions

Do you install Govee permanent lights?

Yes. I install Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights and similar permanent light kits along your roofline, on single and two-storey homes in Greater Saint John.

Can I buy the lights myself?

Yes. Buy a Govee or similar kit wherever you like and I'll install it. Or i can pick up a Govee kit from Costco for you. The kit cost plus a small pickup fee is added to your quote.

How much does permanent light installation cost?

Installation starts at $200. Your final price depends on the length of your roofline and your house, and I confirm it from a photo, usually within a day. An attached garage roofline is +$75, and homes in the Hampton area (Hampton, Lakeside, Smithtown, Nauwigewauk and Norton) have a $25 travel fee. If I pick up the lights for you, the kit cost plus a small pickup fee is added.

Do permanent lights need screws or nails?

Yes. Permanent lights have to be fastened to the house with small screws or nails. I show you exactly where they'll go before I start.

Do you install brands other than Govee?

Yes, I install similar permanent outdoor light kits too. Tell me which one you have or are looking at.

Govee is a trademark of its owner. Port City Christmas Lights is an independent installer and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Govee or Costco.
